definitions.name: Identity person
definitions.description: Corroborate a person against named identity sources; return individual checks, matched fields and gaps.

definitions.name: Identity document
definitions.description: Assess document authenticity and validity; state document type, issuer, expiry and the checks actually performed.

definitions.name: Identity biometric
definitions.description: Return face/fingerprint comparison, liveness or presentation-attack findings with method, reference and thresholds; distinguish 1:1 from 1:N.

definitions.name: Identity address
definitions.description: Corroborate an address using a named source and method; address parsing alone is insufficient.

definitions.name: Identity digital id
definitions.description: Validate a digital-identity assertion, issuer, audience, trust scheme and assurance; session login alone is insufficient.

definitions.name: Identity tax id
definitions.description: Validate a tax identifier in its issuer namespace and return any evidenced name/status match; syntax calculation is not validation.

definitions.name: Business verification
definitions.description: Verify specified business facts against evidenced sources; registry retrieval alone is not a verified business outcome.

definitions.name: Business registry
definitions.description: Retrieve a registered organization, status and filing references in an explicit registry namespace.

definitions.name: Business ownership
definitions.description: Return dated ownership/control edges, interest types, source and completeness; distinguish legal ownership, control and accounting parents.

definitions.name: Business officers
definitions.description: Retrieve officer roles, appointments, resignations and disqualification facts with dates and source.

definitions.name: Screening sanctions
definitions.description: Match against explicitly named sanctions datasets and versions; return candidates and coverage, without a legal clearance decision.

definitions.name: Screening PEP
definitions.description: Return political-exposure candidates, roles, relationships and time intervals under an explicit PEP definition.

definitions.name: Screening adverse media
definitions.description: Return attributed media findings with publication date, language and allegation/proceeding status; do not imply sanctions coverage.

definitions.name: Screening enforcement
definitions.description: Return regulator, court, debarment or enforcement candidates with action type and source; distinguish these from financial sanctions.

definitions.name: Screening payment
definitions.description: Screen payment parties and structured/unstructured payment fields under named lists and policy; not payment execution.

definitions.name: Risk device
definitions.description: Return device identifiers, behavioral/integrity signals, observation times and provider scores; collection is a separate action.

definitions.name: Risk email
definitions.description: Return email validity, reputation and linked-risk signals with observation times and score provenance.

definitions.name: Risk phone
definitions.description: Return telephone line, carrier, validity and risk signals; possession/OTP assurance must be explicitly evidenced.

definitions.name: Risk network
definitions.description: Return network/IP location, proxy and reputation signals; geolocation is probabilistic and not residence verification.

definitions.name: Risk jurisdiction
definitions.description: Retrieve or assess country/jurisdiction risk under a named methodology, publisher and as-of date; separate publication authority from target country.

definitions.name: Risk customer
definitions.description: Return provider risk factors and scores with methodology, scale and input scope; preserve the institution decision separately.

definitions.name: Account ownership
definitions.description: Compare a named subject against account-holder evidence; return per-field comparisons, account namespace and match method.

definitions.name: Financial evidence
definitions.description: Retrieve financial documents or extracted financial facts with institution, period, currency and provenance; not account ownership or transaction surveillance.

definitions.name: Transaction monitoring
definitions.description: Evaluate fiat transaction activity under explicit scenarios/time windows and return alerts, observation coverage and rule versions.

definitions.name: Case management
definitions.description: Manage investigation cases, assignments, dispositions and audit history; this is an operational service contract.

definitions.name: Regulatory reporting
definitions.description: Create, validate or submit regulator-specific reports; distinguish draft, submitted, acknowledged, accepted and rejected.

definitions.name: Crypto wallet
definitions.description: Return wallet attribution/exposure by chain, asset, counterparty and hop policy; a wallet address requires a chain namespace.

definitions.name: Crypto transaction
definitions.description: Return blockchain transaction alerts and exposure with chain, transaction hash, block/time and asset units.

definitions.name: Travel rule exchange
definitions.description: Exchange originator/beneficiary information with protocol and counterparty state; delivery does not prove counterparty acceptance.

definitions.name: EDD report
definitions.description: Retrieve an attributed investigation/due-diligence report with scope, author, dates, evidence and unresolved findings.

definitions.name: Entity resolution
definitions.description: Return identity-resolution candidates and supporting identifiers; preserve candidate versus confirmed links and avoid automatic merges.

definitions.name: Monitoring subscription
definitions.description: Create or manage a change subscription to a specified parent capability, datasets and scope; an active subscription is not a fresh check.

definitions.name: Reference identifier
definitions.description: Resolve a namespaced identifier to reference records; LEI/BIC/reference identity is not beneficial ownership proof.

definitions.name: Reference list
definitions.description: Acquire a versioned list/snapshot/delta with publisher, category, digest and effective time; ingesting a list does not screen a subject.

definitions.name: Workflow orchestration
definitions.description: Run a governed workflow and preserve child capability results; an orchestrator is not assumed to own upstream datasets.

definitions.name: Credential verification
definitions.description: Validate a credential issuer, signature, trust chain, expiry and revocation state; issuance/retrieval is distinct.

definitions.name: Questionnaire collection
definitions.description: Collect or retrieve versioned questionnaire responses with respondent and attestation provenance; a template is not an answered questionnaire.

definitions.name: Identity profile
definitions.description: Retrieve source identity fields or a stored KYC record without asserting corroboration or identity verification.

definitions.name: Identity document extraction
definitions.description: Extract text, barcode/NFC or document fields with field confidence and source pointers; extraction is not authenticity verification.

definitions.name: Identity identifier derivation
definitions.description: Calculate an identifier or perform syntax derivation; output must not be reported as authoritative identifier validation.

definitions.name: Identity vehicle
definitions.description: Validate vehicle identifiers/vehicle facts; this adjacent capability is not person identity verification.

definitions.name: Credential issuance
definitions.description: Issue or manage a credential and expose its lifecycle; issuing does not independently verify underlying facts.

definitions.name: Document evidence
definitions.description: Upload, obtain or export documents/media and their provenance; possession of an artifact is not a check outcome.

definitions.name: Document signature
definitions.description: Create/retrieve electronic signatures, receipts or attestations with scheme and signer provenance; not identity verification.

definitions.name: Screening watchlist
definitions.description: Represent a composite/custom watchlist operation whose categories are parameterized; emit atomic sanctions/PEP/media results only for evidenced categories.

definitions.name: Account control
definitions.description: Validate access/control of an account using microdeposits or account credentials; does not establish that the named subject is its legal holder.

definitions.name: Account profile
definitions.description: Retrieve account metadata or holder details without a subject comparison; not account ownership verification.

definitions.name: Financial transactions
definitions.description: Retrieve, enrich or categorize financial transactions; no AML monitoring conclusion is implied.

definitions.name: Financial balance
definitions.description: Retrieve balance snapshots with amount, currency, balance type and timestamp.

definitions.name: Financial income
definitions.description: Retrieve or assess income/employment evidence with period, source and verification method.

definitions.name: Financial analytics
definitions.description: Retrieve financial features, insights or credit/lending metrics; preserve provider methodology and distinguish computed features from verified evidence.

definitions.name: Financial institution
definitions.description: Retrieve supported financial institution, routing and merchant reference metadata; support catalogs are not customer checks.

definitions.name: Financial personal management
definitions.description: Manage budgets, goals, tags, categories, rewards or other personal-finance resources; adjacent product functionality, not financial-crime evidence.

definitions.name: Questionnaire template
definitions.description: Retrieve questionnaire definitions/standards; a blank template is not a response or attestation.

definitions.name: Platform integration
definitions.description: Manage authentication, sessions, consent, subject records, webhooks, audit logs, queues, diagnostics and native controls. Require an operation_kind and, where known, enables[]; produce no intelligence assertion merely from control success.

definitions.name: Platform testing
definitions.description: Perform sandbox/test setup or webhook simulation; results remain explicitly synthetic and cannot satisfy a live intelligence requirement.
